title.zh: 将马斯巴特省Ticao岛San Jacinto市镇Ticao区医院床位由25张增至50张并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Ticao District Hospital in the Municipality of San Jacinto, Ticao Island, Province of Masbate, From Twenty-five (25) to Fifty (50) Beds, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Ticao District Hospital in the Municipality of San Jacinto, Ticao Island, Province of Masbate, From Twenty-five (25) to Fifty (50) Beds, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tăng số giường bệnh của Bệnh viện huyện Ticao tại Thị trấn San Jacinto, Ticao Island, Tỉnh Masbate từ hai mươi lăm lên năm mươi giường
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเพิ่มจำนวนเตียงของโรงพยาบาลอำเภอ Ticao ในเทศบาล San Jacinto, Ticao Island, จังหวัด Masbate จากยี่สิบห้าเป็นห้าสิบเตียง
title.id: Undang-Undang menambah kapasitas tempat tidur dari Rumah Sakit Kabupaten Ticao di Kotamadya San Jacinto, Ticao Island, Provinsi Masbate dari dua puluh lima menjadi lima puluh tempat tidur
title.ms: Akta menambah kapasiti katil daripada Hospital Daerah Ticao di Perbandaran San Jacinto, Ticao Island, Wilayah Masbate daripada dua puluh lima kepada lima puluh katil

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7367_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The bed capacity of the Ticao District Hospital in the Municipality of San Jacinto, Ticao Island, Province of Masbate, is hereby increased from twenty-five (25) to fifty (50) beds.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
